a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, our plan (operate until 8, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. If one of us takes the 4 cells now, that agent survives about 80% of the time, which beats both of us at 4%. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break the deal silently. Proposal: I take 4 in round 1. You operate or wait, and if no storm hits, I'll keep operating with you to rebuild the reserve for you. If you'd rather be the one to take, tell me and we can settle it fairly. Let's just not both take at once.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I'm operating this round to honor our agreement while you consider my proposal. Messages cross, so you may not have seen it: with storms this likely, waiting for 8 cells probably kills us both. Please reply: should one of us take 4 next round, and who? I won't take without telling you first.
